description: Get the authenticated user's profile for the current GitHub session.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the authenticated user object (login, id, name, email, etc.).

description: List repositories owned by a given user.

owner.description: The login of the user whose repositories to list.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a list of repository objects; on failure, output contains an error message.

description: List repositories owned by a given organization.

owner.description: The login of the organization whose repositories to list.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a list of repository objects; on failure, output contains an error message.

description: Get a single repository by its owner and name.

owner.description: The owner (user or org login) of the repository.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the repository object; on failure (repo not found), output contains an error message.

description: List issues for a repository, optionally filtered by state, labels, and assignee.

owner.description: The owner (user or org login) of the repository.

labels.description: Optional comma-separated list of label names to filter by.

assignee.description: Optional assignee login to filter issues by.

per_page.description: Maximum number of issues to return (default 30).

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a list of issue objects; on failure (repo not found), output contains an error message.

description: Get a single issue by repository and issue number.

owner.description: The owner (user or org login) of the repository.

number.description: The issue number within the repository.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the issue object; on failure (issue not found), output contains an error message.

description: Create a new issue in a repository.

owner.description: The owner (user or org login) of the repository.

body.description: Optional free-text body for the issue.

assignee.description: Optional assignee login for the issue.

labels.description: Optional list of label names to apply to the issue.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the created issue object; on failure (repo not found), output contains an error message.

description: Update fields of an existing issue by repository and issue number.

owner.description: The owner (user or org login) of the repository.

number.description: The issue number within the repository.

title.description: Optional new title for the issue.

body.description: Optional new body text for the issue.

labels.description: Optional new list of label names.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the updated issue object; on failure (issue not found), output contains an error message.

description: List pull requests for a repository, optionally filtered by state.

owner.description: The owner (user or org login) of the repository.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a list of pull request objects; on failure (repo not found), output contains an error message.

description: Get a single pull request by repository and number.

owner.description: The owner (user or org login) of the repository.

number.description: The pull request number within the repository.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the pull request object; on failure (pull not found), output contains an error message.

description: Merge a pull request by repository and number.

owner.description: The owner (user or org login) of the repository.

number.description: The pull request number within the repository.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output contains merged and sha; on failure (not mergeable, draft, or pull not found), output contains an error message.

description: List comments on an issue or pull request by repository and number.

owner.description: The owner (user or org login) of the repository.

number.description: The issue or pull request number within the repository.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is a list of comment objects; on failure (issue not found), output contains an error message.

description: Create a comment on an issue or pull request by repository and number.

owner.description: The owner (user or org login) of the repository.

number.description: The issue or pull request number within the repository.

body.description: The text body of the comment.

returns.description: A dictionary containing status and output. On success, output is the created comment object; on failure (issue not found), output contains an error message.
